newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-HOLTZ TO ANALYZE COLLEGE FOOTBALL ON CBS.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-HOLTZ TO ANALYZE COLLEGE FOOTBALL ON CBS.

text.p: Former Notre Dame head football coach Lou Holtz, who resigned before last season, will become a college football television analyst for CBS television, CBS SportsLine said on Wednesday.
Holtz, 60, spent the last 11 of his 27-years as a head football coach at Notre Dame, where he was 100-30-2. He won a national championship in 1988.
Holtz' future seemed clouded when Notre Dame finished with an 8-3 record in his last year.
